verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-settable custom instructions or persistent preferences that shape Poke's responses. The only related item is a passing mention that account merging keeps "Poke's Memory," which shows a memory feature exists but says nothing about configuring instructions. Recipe-level inputContext and prefilled first messages are per-recipe setup fields, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
